main_text.p: h[?] ra[?] pa[?] Sc[?] spirâsse deprehensus est. Imò vt intelligant Regicidarum Patroni, quantum abhorruerit bonus hic & pius Episcopus, à sacris Principum licèt scelerato-rum personis temerâdis: audiant illum eorum reprehensores, nō gladijs jugulos, sed linguis tatum famam impetentes ita monentem, objurgantem (nec pigebat hic ex illo de Pastorali Cura Libro suauissimo, integram paene Paginā attexere, cum tanta sit & personae loquentis grauitas, & loquutionis ad præsens ꝑpositum confirmandum claritas.

Sic igitur verba se habēt. [De Pasto-rali Cura. rt.3.adm.{h}Admonendi sunt subditi, ne præpositorum suorū vitam temerè judicent, si quid eos fortasse agere deprehensibiliter vident: ne vnde mala rectè redarguunt, inde ꝑe-lationis impulsum in ꝓfundiora mergantur. Admonēdi sunt, ne cùm culpas præpositorum consīderant, contra eos audaciores fiat: sed sic si qua valdè sunt eorum praua, apud semetipsos dijudi-cent, vt tamen diuino timore cōstrićti, ferre sub eis jugum reuerentiæ non re-cusent. Quod melius ostendimus, si Da-uid factum ad medium deducam°. Saul quippe

page.notes: The note fragment is cut off at the scan edge, so the words are only partly visible. Each fragment is marked [?]. Marginal note text is partly abbreviated and the left-margin lines are hard to separate; "rt.3.adm." is doubtful. The mark before "Admonendi" and the reading "subditi" are uncertain. The paragraph break before "Sic igitur" is uncertain. The running head is followed by "LIB. III", which is not included in the running head.
